command: From the Go application workspace: go run /path/to/generate.go /absolute/path/to/output.obk
scope: The Go store saved and reopened a 10 mm cube with a zero-DOF sketch, width and height expressions referencing size, six distinct face keys, and six planar 1 cm² faces. The face keys were checked after Go replay and recorded externally in observations.json.
After reopening, changing size to 20 mm through the parameter graph and recomputing produced a 20 × 20 × 10 mm block. The Go feature serializer stores an evaluated extrusion distance.
limitations: The saved Go document does not contain a dependent face reference; the captured keys are an external fixture.
This does not prove that Rust can import the Go model or resolve any of its face keys.
The Go extent parameter relationship does not survive in this format. A Rust import must not invent that relationship.
The fixture contains generated document identity values, so a regenerated file need not be byte-identical.
